reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime and parks for free. We'd maybe go once or twice a month, so a membership doesn't pay off and $14 a kid adds up fast.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and I can get the kids out for free at the library and parks.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower drop-in, like $6-7 a kid, or a free-entry day each month. I'd also need to hear a few other moms say it was worth it.
